{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows low positive sentiment (e.g., 0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent true outcomes show sharp downward drift after a spike.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices (last 3-5 days) when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast is > 10% above recent 15-day average, reduce by 10-20%.",
    "If sentiment history includes a 0.67 or higher value, increase forecast by 5-10% to account for bullish momentum.",
    "Avoid over-optimism in early forecast periods (e.g., first 5 days of 30d window) — apply conservative bias.",
    "Correct for lag: if true outcome is significantly lower than forecast at day 10-15, adjust downward by 5-15% for subsequent days.",
    "When sentiment history shows a 0.33 value, reduce forecast by 5-10% to reflect cautious market behavior."
  ]
}
